why: In both chats ChatGPT recommended a single travel tripod (Sirui Traveler 5C, Ulanzi Zero Y, Peak Design Travel Tripod) with its ball head included, and never told the shopper to add a second item. The one fact that matters is whether the tripod's load rating fits the camera and heaviest lens, and that is a model choice within one product, not a set of items (Dealectric lists no tripods in any store either).
